devdoc.details: Allows creation of new agent collections if the caller holds enough tokens.

AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

InsufficientBalance(uint256,uint256).details: The ETH balance of the account is not enough to perform the operation.

InsufficientBalanceInAuthorizedTokens().details: Error thrown when the caller does not hold enough tokens to create a collection.

TokenAlreadyAuthorized(address).details: Error thrown when the token is already authorized for collection creation.

params.token: The address of the token that is already authorized.

TokenNotAuthorized(address).details: Error thrown when the token is not authorized for collection creation.

params.token: The address of the token that is not authorized.

AuthorizedTokenAdded(address).details: Emitted when a new token is authorized for collection creation.

AuthorizedTokenRemoved(address).details: Emitted when a token is removed from the list of authorized tokens for collection creation.

DefaultCollectionsDescriptorUpdated(addr.details: Emitted when the collections descriptor is updated.

params.newDescriptor: The address of the new collections descriptor.
params.oldDescriptor: The address of the old collections descriptor.

MinimumTokenBalanceForCreationUpdated(ad.details: Emitted when minimum token balance for collection creation is updated.

params.newMinimumBalance: The new minimum balance required for collection creation.
params.oldMinimumBalance: The old minimum balance required for collection creation.
params.token: The address of the token for which the minimum balance was updated.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted to signal this.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

addAuthorizedTokenForCreation(address,ui.details: Add a new token that can be used to create collections.

params.minimumBalance: Minimum balance required to create a collection with this token.
params.token: Address of the token to authorize.

canCreateCollection(address).details: Check if the account can create a collection based on its token balances.

params.account: Address of the account to check.

returns._0: True if the account can create a collection, false otherwise.

params.initialCollectionImplementation: Address of the implementation for new collections.
params.initialCollectionsDescriptor: Address of the descriptor for new collections.

createCollection(string,string,string,ad.details: Create a new agent collection contract.

returns.collectionAddress: Address of the newly created collection.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

hasMinimumCollateralLockedForCreation(ad.details: Check if the account has a minimum collateral locked in any of the authorized tokens for creation.

params.account: Address of the account to check.

returns._0: True if the account has a minimum collateral locked in any authorized token, false

hasMinimumTokenBalanceForCreation(addres.details: Check if the account has a minimum balance in any of the authorized tokens for creation.

params.account: Address of the account to check.

returns._0: True if the account has a minimum balance in any authorized token, false otherwise

removeAuthorizedTokenForCreation(address.details: Remove a token that can be used to create collections.

params.token: Address of the token to remove.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.newDescriptor: The new default descriptor for the new collections.

updateMinimumTokenBalanceForCreation(add.details: Update the minimum token balance required to create a collection with a specific token.

params.newMinimum: New minimum balance required to create a collection with this token.
params.token: Address of the token for which to update the minimum balance.

authorizedTokensForCreation.details: Get the token required to create a collection.

params.index: Index of the token in the authorized tokens list.

authorizedTokensForCreation.return: Address of the authorized token for collection creation.

returns._0: Address of the authorized token for collection creation.

collectionsDescriptor.return: Address of the default collections descriptor.

returns._0: Address of the default collections descriptor.

isAuthorizedTokenForCreation.details: Get if a token is authorized for collection creation.

params.token: Address of the token to check.

isAuthorizedTokenForCreation.return: True if the token is authorized for collection creation, false otherwise.

returns._0: True if the token is authorized for collection creation, false otherwise.

minimumTokenBalanceForCreation.details: Get the minimum token balance required to create a collection with a specific token.

params.token: Address of the token to check.

minimumTokenBalanceForCreation.return: Minimum token balance required to create a collection with the specified token.

returns._0: Minimum token balance required to create a collection with the specified token.
